Author: JustPixelll
Name: Should I?
Punchline: Know what to sell, what to buy, and where your gil goes.
Description: FFXIV economy intelligence suite: sell optimization, executable buy discovery, native verification, gil cashflow tracking, FIFO trading P&L, and personal Market Board analytics.
Changelog: v1.1.8 adds exact current-listing state age (price + quantity), expands Should I Tycoon? with an observed gil cashflow ledger and editable income/spend categories, and lets normal Market Board purchases be marked Personal so crafting/glamour buys remain in spending history without polluting FIFO trading positions or P&L.
